Stonemason Kith is a duergar Trader who can be found at Grymforge during Act One.
“
The past is nearer than we think. We simply must dig.
„
— Kith

Involvement

Act One

Stonemason Kith is investigating the history of the Grymforge together with  Gergerann at X: -660 Y: 375. If the party speak with him, the first time they do so he asks for their assistance. A party member can examine the statue, rubble and general area. Upon passing each skill check, they discover that the statue is recent, implying two different eras of occupants to the fortress, and that the rubble and glassy stones within the debris indicate the nearby wall was smashed through by something large from the Hells. If the party member passes all three skill checks and reports to Kith, he gifts them a piece of  Infernal Alloy and party members with the Guild Artisan background receive the ⁠Expert Opinion inspiration. Otherwise, the infernal alloy can be purchased from his inventory.

The interacting party member must pass three of the following skill checks:

  • [INVESTIGATION] Examine the fallen rubble. (DC 10)
  • [RANGER] [INVESTIGATION] Examine the fallen rubble. (DC 5)
  • [PERCEPTION] Survey the area for unseen curiosities. (DC 10)
  • [HISTORY] Assess the statue for technique and composition. (DC 10)

Bards only need to pass one skill check:

  • [BARD] [HISTORY] Try to remember the tome "Fables of Forges Grym". (DC 10)  Advantage
  • [BARD] [DECEPTION] I know everything about this place. In fact, it was hand-forged by a flumph called Grym... (DC 20)
